envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: the concept's own gloss names it a role, and role is the sign the corpus already uses for it (the Role dimension of every agent, role routing, the harness's model roles); position was a second sign for the same concept
envelope.cause: operator: architect position is a duplicate of the established sign architect role

payload.gloss: the role an agent holds is what its host routes a model by. Each agent carries to the harness the role it holds, never a model; the host decides which model fills each role. Where the host has decided nothing, the agent runs on the harness's nearest built-in route for that kind of work (its ordinary default where it has none), or, on a harness that routes only by tier, on the tier suited to the role's work: work that holds, cuts or judges against the design (architect, planner, assayer) on the top tier; spec-bounded work (implementer, integrator) on the middle tier. Install makes the roles visible to the host as something it can set, and never changes a choice the host has made.
